name: transfer_demo
description: Open the Transfer Funds page and transfer 100 dollars from account 13344 to account 13566

approved_plan.goal: Open the Transfer Funds page and transfer 100 dollars from account 13344 to account 13566

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using username and password parameters

steps.intent: Navigate to the Transfer Funds page
steps.action: Click the 'Transfer Funds' link in the authenticated navigation menu

steps.intent: Fill in the transfer form: enter the amount, select the source account and the destination account
steps.action: Enter transfer_amount in the amount field, select from_account_id as the source account, and select to_account_id as the destination account
Click the 'Transfer' button to submit the form
